test_matmul_dataframe_dataframe: test the @ operator computes matrix multiplication between two DataFrames with matching inner dimensions
test_matmul_dataframe_series: test the @ operator computes matrix multiplication between a DataFrame and a Series returning a Series
test_matmul_numpy_array_dataframe: test the @ operator computes matrix multiplication between a numpy array and a DataFrame returning a DataFrame
test_matmul_nested_list_dataframe: test the @ operator computes matrix multiplication between a nested list and a DataFrame via __rmatmul__
test_matmul_mixed_dtype: test the @ operator handles mixed dtype DataFrames and different dtype DataFrames correctly
test_matmul_unaligned_error: test the @ operator raises ValueError with aligned message when shapes are not aligned
test_matmul_error_message_shapes: test the @ operator error message reflects original operand shapes not transposed shapes
